step_free_entry.evidence: Exterior threshold and entryway steps leading to the front entrance are not visible.

grab_bars.evidence: No grab bars are present around the toilet or inside the bathtub enclosure.

good_lighting_and_contrast.evidence: The rooms are well-lit with high contrast between dark wood-look flooring and light neutral walls.
